tbesh_html:
1) consecrated or devoted one, Nazarite
1a) consecrated one
1b) devotee, Nazarite
1c) untrimmed (vine)
Also named: ne.zer (נֵ֫זֶר ": consecration" H5145)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: separate, i.e. consecrated (as prince, a Nazirite); hence (figuratively from the latter) an unpruned vine (like an unshorn Nazirite)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: Nazarite (by a false alliteration with Nazareth), separate(-d), vine undressed.
